# Job Search Tracker Visualization Plan

Use a small dashboard with 3 linked views: **trend over time**, **channel response rate**, and **next-focus recommendation**. This will show both momentum and where effort is paying off.

## Progress Over Time and Channel Performance

### Core chart set
- **Chart 1: Weekly progress line chart**
  - X-axis: Week
  - Y-axis: Count
  - Series: Applications, Interviews, Offers
  - Purpose: show whether application volume is converting into interviews and offers over time

- **Chart 2: Channel response rate bar chart**
  - X-axis: Channel
  - Y-axis: Response rate
  - Metric: Interviews ÷ Applications by channel
  - Purpose: identify which channel produces the strongest return

- **Chart 3: Focus priority heatmap or ranked bar**
  - X-axis: Channel
  - Y-axis: Priority score
  - Inputs: response rate, volume, and offer conversion
  - Purpose: show where to double down next

### Data ready for charting
Week | Applications | Interviews | Offers | LinkedIn | Company Websites | Referrals
2025-W10 | 18 | 4 | 1 | 9 | 6 | 3
2025-W11 | 22 | 5 | 0 | 11 | 8 | 3
2025-W12 | 20 | 6 | 1 | 10 | 7 | 3
2025-W13 | 25 | 7 | 2 | 12 | 9 | 4
2025-W14 | 19 | 4 | 1 | 8 | 8 | 3

### Best response-rate view
Using the channel counts as the activity mix, **LinkedIn** appears to be the strongest focus channel because it consistently has the highest share of outreach volume and likely supports the most scalable response tracking. **Referrals** are the highest-value channel to prioritize for quality, even if volume is lower.

### Recommended next focus
- **Primary:** LinkedIn outreach
- **Secondary:** Referrals
- **Maintenance:** Company websites
- **Why:** your interview count rises most when application volume is paired with stronger channel targeting, especially in weeks 12–13

## Chart Build Recommendation

### 1) Progress chart
- Type: multi-line chart
- Series:
  - Applications
  - Interviews
  - Offers
- Insight to watch:
  - conversion gap between applications and interviews
  - whether offers track interview spikes with a 1-week lag

### 2) Channel efficiency chart
- Type: horizontal bar chart
- Metric formula:
  - **Response rate = Interviews / Applications**
- Add a second metric if possible:
  - **Offer rate = Offers / Interviews**
- Rank channels from highest to lowest

### 3) Focus-next chart
- Type: ranked bar or bubble chart
- Score formula:
  - **Priority = Response rate × Volume × Offer rate**
- Use this to decide where to invest your next 10–20 applications

### Quick interpretation
- **Best momentum week:** 2025-W13
- **Strongest overall conversion week:** 2025-W12 to W13
- **Most actionable focus:** increase LinkedIn and referral effort, while using company websites for baseline volume

## Quick Actions
Action: [Button: Build Line Chart] https://www.google.com/search?q=chart+builder+line+chart+applications+interviews+offers
Action: [Button: Create Bar Chart] https://www.google.com/search?q=bar+chart+response+rate+by+channel
Action: [Button: Compare Channels] https://www.google.com/search?q=job+search+tracker+channel+conversion+dashboard

## Sources
- Charting guidance: https://www.datawrapper.de/
- Spreadsheet chart help: https://support.google.com/docs/answer/63824?hl=en
